guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: currencyservice has the largest anomalies (latency-90 +698%, z=139.6) and the slowest traces all pass through it, with frontend and checkoutservice latency rising downstream; its memory rose +217% (4.1e7 to 1.3e8, z=+43). Socket count (+104%) and diskio (0 to 4.5e9) also moved, so the fault type is ambiguous, and memory is chosen as the largest resource shift, but no logs or errors confirm it.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or roll currencyservice pods to clear memory pressure, and inspect its memory usage and heap growth, socket and disk I/O behavior before and after to confirm the fault type.
